_doc: Signal Flap rules, read by backend/src/signal_flap/engine.rs and frontend/src/games/signal-flap/engine.ts. Lengths are in arena units (100 units = 1 logical pixel of a 480 x 640 arena), times in ticks (60 per second), speeds in units per tick. Change both engines' tests (shared/flap_vectors.json) together.
_moving: From gap `moving_from` on, `pct_start` % of gaps slide up and down (+`pct_step` per gap, up to `pct_max`), between `amp_min` and `amp_max` from their centre, at `speed_min`..`speed_max` per tick.
_bars: A signal bar sits between two towers (from the 2nd tower on) with `pct` % chance, near the middle of the two gaps, up to `spread` off.
